b: I have an issue and like some advice. I am a professional who has been working in data and analytics for about 8 years. I started off my career as a data analyst and BI developer and then slowly transitioned to more PM roles. I got laid off in 2024 and had a really hard time landing a new role. I was unemployed for like 10 months. The job market is trash but I also think it didn’t help that the job I got laid off from didn’t have an industry standard equivalent. Nonetheless, I finally got an offer that was for a far more junior role but I was desperate and I took it. I quickly realized that the junior role was not a good fit and decided to keep looking. I stayed in that role for a year and found a new role that felt like a better fit. I am now a data governance manager but am having a hard time adjusting. I think it may not be a good cultural fit and so I’ve been thinking about starting the job search again (I’m about 3 months in). I am tired of job hunting and starting over but I really can’t and don’t want to stay at a job that makes me miserable. I can take accountability for my role in this but I’m wondering if it should seriously start a new job search given my short tenure at my last few roles. Additionally, I don’t know if the misfit is due to a skills gap or a culture fit.
